recovery_note: Do not generalize the old empty-store cleanup. The populated driver needs a bounded byte/identity inventory and explicit handling of partially completed publication, retained references and archived snapshots.
scope_limits: No invocation of old permit issuers, old worker runners, compiler fixtures, proxies, originals, collectors or privileged sampler functions.
Use only NativeProcesses.identity and NativeProcesses.executable from the sampler module.
Keep Q worker/controller sources immutable; unexpected integration findings must become owned pre-execution repairs.
Retirement and selected observation work receipts remain synthetic; the actual cancelled worker receipt is distinct.
Prove selected cooperative-writer behavior only; no arbitrary-writer or power-loss claim.
sequence: Validate the final admission commit, active execution leaf and exact allowed dirty live pointers.
Authenticate all committed driver/worker/source pins and current selected installed interpreter bytes before issuing any permit.
Create the output and canonical sealed one-use permit exclusively only in the later execution leaf.
The executing driver consumes a separate exclusive start marker, binds its own native identity and writes the exact worker authority.
Create only the fixed case store, publisher workspaces and optional evidence directory; initialize private modes and inert wrapper bytes.
Launch fixed Perl workers through the committed controller, admit all native images and births, then seal each case activation.
Pump all current worker pipes while following the fixed action schedule; require an actual busy event before releasing a contended lock.
Before cancellation seal the original acquisition packet by digest; settle the actual child/group before the peer adopts it.
Finish ordinary workers, recover every launched child on any failure, and preserve the first error and full bounded captures.
Independently inspect and record the bounded owned trees; remove only exact admitted objects after all workers settle.
Retain raw outcomes, the state/identity join and exact cleanup. Any unknown node or incomplete native cleanup is an owned failure, never silently removed or promoted.
source_bounds: review.json re-derives the conservative fixed model shapes and rejects undersized ceilings; these encodings are not native execution evidence.
